title: Glowing gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bagGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5ea8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c3216e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffcf3d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='42' ry='38' fill='#fff2a8' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.22'/>
  <!-- bag body -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='52' height='54' rx='6' fill='url(#bagGrad)'/>
  <!-- bag top fold -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='52' height='10' rx='6' fill='#ff8fc2'/>
  <!-- bag bottom shade -->
  <rect x='24' y='80' width='52' height='8' rx='6' fill='#9c1a58'/>
  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M36 34 C36 18, 64 18, 64 34' fill='none' stroke='#ffd45e' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M50 66 C44 58, 36 62, 40 69 C42 73, 47 76, 50 79 C53 76, 58 73, 60 69 C64 62, 56 58, 50 66 Z' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M18 24 L20 30 L26 32 L20 34 L18 40 L16 34 L10 32 L16 30 Z' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <path d='M82 60 L83.5 64 L88 65.5 L83.5 67 L82 71 L80.5 67 L76 65.5 L80.5 64 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M76 22 L77 25 L80 26 L77 27 L76 30 L75 27 L72 26 L75 25 Z' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='90' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='94' r='2' fill='#fff6b0'/>
</svg>
